acquisition method: up to 15 dynamically chosen most abundant precursor ions, with “peptide preferable” profile, were fragmented
cleavage agent: Trypsin was added (0.3 μg per sample)
collision energy: higher-energy collisional dissociation–based fragmentation (normalized collision energy 25)
enrichment method: To identify mitochondrial MiNT-interacting protein partners, we used a coimmunoprecipitation (Co-IP) approach
fragmentation method: followed by higher-energy collisional dissociation–based fragmentation
instrument: MS analysis was performed using a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
labeling: Relative protein quantification in MaxQuant was performed using the label-free quantification algorithm.
ptm: The search included cysteine carbamidomethylation as a fixed modification and oxidation of methionine as variable modifications
reduction reagent: resuspended in 100 μL of 8M urea, 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT)
reduction concentration: resuspended in 100 μL of 8M urea, 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT)
